title: Arahatā
text: 2. Cha yimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni cha || || Cakkhundriyam || pe || manindriyaṃ || || 3. Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imesaṃ channam indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samadaññā vimutto ti || ||
